text: ใช้กังหันทดน้ำ
style: Speak natural standard Central Thai (Bangkok) as a native Thai voice actor dubbing a Chinese costume drama; no foreign accent, clear tones, natural rhythm and polite particles only where written. A 23-year-old young master of the Wei clan, male: clear, arrogant and contemptuous; his voice tightens when Line direction (written in Chinese; never read it aloud, speak only the Thai line): 搶先開口，快，一口氣說完
